Guidance & outlook: On a sequential basis, consolida ted PBIT increased by 11.6% from INR 102 crores in Q4 FY'26 to INR 114 crores in Q1 FY27.
We gave a guidance of INR 400 crores for the full year FY'27 and we keep the same guidance.
Standalone unallocable expense of Q1 FY'27 was INR 17 crores compared to unallocable income of INR 60 crores in Q1 FY26 and unallocable income of INR 11 crores in Q4 FY'26.
Growth & demand: To begin with, I will start with the standalone performance: In Q1 FY'27, standalone sales were INR 846 crores compared to INR 698 crores in Q1 FY '26, which is a growth of 21.2%.
Electrominerals segment grew by 33%, Ceramics segment grew by 15.2%, and Abrasive segment grew by 14.7%.
This marks a growth of 14.3% on a like-to-like basis.
Margins & costs: If you remember, consolidated PAT in Q4 FY'26 included exceptional items, costs of about INR 135 crores related to CUMI Awuko Abrasives and Foskor Zirconia (Pty) Limited.
Besides this, raw material cost push, normal inflationary cost push and other costs were there.
Foskor, a 51% subsidiary of CUMI International, Cyprus, was determined commercially unviable due to sustained loss, rising input costs and marketing pressures.
Capex & expansion: Carborundum Universal Limited August 10, 2026 Consolidated CAPEX in Q1 FY'27 was INR 53 crores compared to INR 64 crores in Q1 FY'26.
We retained our CAPEX guidance of about Rs 400 crores in FY'27.

It includes expansion in advanced Ceramics for power electronics including substrate, metallized tubes, rings, brazed assemblies, expansion of brown -fused alumina, addition of integrated furnace facility for thermal spray powders, zirconia furnace, grain...
Balance sheet & cash: Standalone profit after tax in Q1 FY'27: Standalone PAT was INR 88 crores compared to INR 77 crores in Q1 FY'26 without the impact of one-time dividend of INR 68 crores received from a subsidiary in Q1 FY '26.
Profit of Q4 FY '26 included dividend income of subsidiaries and JVs of INR 30.5 crores compared to a dividend income of INR 14.5 crores in Q1 FY'27.
Standalone PBIT was INR 115 crores in Q1 FY'27 compared to INR 98 crores in Q1 FY'26, excluding the one-time dividend of INR 68 crores in Q1 FY'26.
Risks & challenges: On a sequential basis , PAT declined by 28.3% from INR 120 crores in Q4 FY '26 to INR 88 crores in Q1 FY '27.
Electrominerals PBIT increased from INR 7 crores to INR 39 crores, while Ceramics and Abrasive PBIT declined marginally to INR 59 crores and INR 34 crores respectively.
On a sequential basis, PBIT declined from INR 60 crores in Q4 FY '26 to INR 34 crores in Q1 FY '27, while PBIT margin declined from 17.1% to 10.4%.

guidance.t: I will quickly touch upon the guidance that we shared last time: I communicated earlier that the consolidated sales could grow approximately 4% to 4.5% in FY'27.

However, if we exclude the revenue contribution from Foskor Zirconia and A wuko which accounted for INR 343 crores in FY'26 and compare d it with our business pl an, the comparable growth will be 11% to 12%.
Carborundum Universal Limited August 10, 2026 Consolidated Abrasive margins were expected to be around 9.5% to 10% .
However, if we exclude the Awuko loss, the comparable margin for FY'26 would be 7.9%.
We retained our CAPEX guidance of about Rs 400 crores in FY'27.

Risks & challenges: 29/2026 Mutual Fund investments are subject to market risks, read all scheme related documents carefully.

Guidance & outlook: In Q4 FY26, standalone Sales recorded at INR 845 crores, compared to INR 769 crores in Q2 FY26, reflecting a sequential growth of 9.9%, compared to INR 687 crores in Q4 FY26.
Abrasives grew from INR 323 crores in Q3 FY26 to INR 353 crores in Q4 FY26, marking an increase of 9.3% sequentially and compared to Q4 FY25, it recorded a strong growth of 21.5%.
Ceramic increased from INR 255 crores in Q3 FY26 to INR 279 crores in Q4 FY26, marking an increase of 9.2% sequentially and compared to Q4 FY25, it grew by 21.7%.
